name: discr_prime_pow_ne_two
statement: Fact p.Prime] (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (p ^ (k + 1))) (hirr : Irreducible (cyclotomic (p ^ (k + 1)) K)) (hk : p ^ (k + 1) ≠ 2) : discr K (hζ.powerBasis K).basis = (-1) ^ ((p ^ (k + 1)).totient / 2) * p ^ (p ^ k * ((p - 1) * (k + 1) - 1))

name: discr_odd_prime
statement: Fact p.Prime] (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ p) (hirr : Irreducible (cyclotomic p K)) (hodd : p ≠ 2) : discr K (hζ.powerBasis K).basis = (-1) ^ ((p - 1) / 2) * p ^ (p - 2)
